stories.headline: Dream On, Indeed: Aerosmith Rock Again With Dave Grohl on Drums
stories.blurb: Aerosmith played their first show in three years Thursday at the Hollywood Bowl, their first since Steven Tyler's vocal injury ended their touring days. Dave Grohl drummed most of the six-song set, Johnny Depp jumped in on guitar, and original drummer Joey Kramer came back for "Walk This Way." Guns N' Roses warmed things up by covering three Aerosmith songs. There's a second show this Sunday, November 1.
stories.quip: Dave Grohl will drum for literally anyone who asks nicely, and we love him for it.

stories.headline: The Death Stranding Anime Delivers Its First Teaser
stories.blurb: Kojima Productions and Disney+ dropped the first teaser for Death Stranding Isolations, an anime series set just after Sam connects North America to the Chiral Network. Hideo Kojima is executive producer, Takayuki Sano directs, and it arrives on Disney+ in 2027. The tagline is "My mom became a crater," which is extremely Kojima.
stories.quip: Somewhere a BB is already crying about the release window.

stories.headline: Who You Gonna Call? A Life-Size Stay Puft Took Over a Neighborhood
stories.blurb: Just in time for Halloween, a video on Instagram shows a house with a giant inflatable Stay Puft Marshmallow Man that towers over the roof and can be seen way up the street. The comments are split between people asking where to buy one and people saying it's worth the HOA fine.
stories.quip: The HOA has been officially slimed.

stories.headline: Pokemon and Fender Made Guitars With an 8-Bit Switch
stories.blurb: Fender is teaming up with The Pokemon Company on two Made in Japan guitars for the Red and Green 30th anniversary: a Pokemon Red Stratocaster and a Pokemon Green Telecaster. Both have pixel art, a Poke Ball neck plate and an 8-bit audio toggle for instant retro tones. They launch next year, with pre-orders coming to the Pokemon Center.
stories.quip: Finally, a way to shred the Route 1 theme at full volume.

stories.headline: Queens of the Stone Age Drop Their New Album Perfecth
stories.blurb: Queens of the Stone Age just released Perfecth, their ninth studio album, with nine songs mixing their old robot rock with moody art rock. The singles included "Easy Street" and the perfectly timed "Where the Goth Girls At?" Consequence gave it a B+.
stories.quip: A song called "Where the Goth Girls At?" out on Halloween weekend. Josh Homme knows what he's doing.

stories.headline: HBO's Harry Potter Finds Its Ghosts and Its Sorting Hat
stories.blurb: Just in time for spooky season, HBO's Harry Potter series cast its Hogwarts ghosts. Leo Bill is Nearly Headless Nick, Andrew Brooke is the Bloody Baron and Daniel Fearn is the Fat Friar. David Threlfall voices the Sorting Hat, and Laura Smyth plays the Fat Lady guarding Gryffindor Tower.
stories.quip: Nearly Headless Nick has been waiting decades for this role. Well, centuries.

stories.headline: Japan Is Getting Life-Size Rathalos and Lagiacrus Statues
stories.blurb: Capcom is building life-size statues of Monster Hunter's Rathalos and Lagiacrus in Fukuoka, Japan. They'll stand in the middle of a new park at Marinoa Resort by the water, facing off like they're about to throw down. Fans finally get a pilgrimage spot of their own.
stories.quip: Bring a Great Sword for the photo op. Leave the actual hunting at home.

stories.headline: A Real-Life Candy Land Is Opening in Midtown
stories.blurb: Candy Land NYC, the first Candy Land store in the U.S., opens this November next to the New York Hilton Midtown at Sixth Avenue and 54th Street. You follow the game path through realms like the Candied Apple Orchard, build your own candy mix, and shop toys and merch. No exact opening date yet.
stories.quip: Please, nobody draw the Plumpy card on the way in.

stories.headline: Gangster Granny Is the Oldest Crowd-Surfer Ever
stories.blurb: Pauline Kana, known online as Gangster Granny, is officially the world's oldest crowd-surfer, per Guinness World Records. She was 99 years and 274 days old when the crowd at a Brantley Gilbert show in Texas carried her through the mosh pit for more than three minutes. She has since turned 100 and celebrated her 100th Halloween.
stories.quip: Your excuse for skipping the mosh pit just expired.

stories.headline: Archaeologists Found Troy's First Known Musical Instrument
stories.blurb: Digs at ancient Troy in Turkiye turned up a roughly 2,700-year-old bone flute fragment, the first identifiable musical instrument ever found there. The same team also found a 4,500-year-old idol head buried under the floor of an old citadel gate. Both come from eras before and after the Troy of Homer's epics.
stories.quip: Somebody at Troy was practicing the flute, and the neighbors definitely heard it.
